plain_text:
Figure 1: Effect of adding a third host on persistence. Each point represent the position of a third
optimum, while the two other optima are fixed, at the respective positions $(-\beta,0)$ and $(\beta,0)$ , pictured in
blue. The colormap corresponds to the value taken by the difference $\lambda_2 - \lambda_3$ , depending on the position
of the third optimum. Each row corresponds to a different value of $\delta$ and each line to a different value of
$\beta$ . We assumed here that $\mu^2/2 = \alpha = 1$ .
